newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain peseta seen held above 84.15 per mark.
newsitem.headline: Spain peseta seen held above 84.15 per mark.

text.p: Spain's peseta was little changed against the mark at midday on Wednesday, apparently unaffected by a stronger dollar against the German currency, dealers said.

Dealers said expectations of intervention by the Bank of Spain at levels just above 84.15 pesetas were containing the Spanish currency, although there was no clear sign of the central bank buying marks in the market.
At 1040 GMT the peseta was trading at 84.16/19 per mark versus 84.16/18 in late trade on Tuesday.
"It's very strange that despite external factors the
peseta won't budge below around 84.15 and won't go above 84.30 to the mark. You never really know with the Bank of Spain whether it's in there or not," said a dealer at a foreign bank in Madrid.
The dollar was trading at 153.95/98 pesetas versus 152.63/68 in late trade on Tuesday.
The dollar was trading at 1.8287/92 marks, off a high of 1.83 after upbeat comments on Tuesday by U.S. Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan which pushed up U.S. asset markets.
